Instrument.name: 2001 Mars Odyssey Spacecraft High Energy Neutron Detector
Instrument.description: The 2001 Mars Odyssey Spacecraft (ODY) High-Energy Neutron Detector (HEND) is part of the Mars Odyssey Gamma-Ray Spectrometer suite. HEND is specifically designed to measure high-energy neutrons. The chief scientific objectives of the HEND instrument are to map the near surface hydrogen (and, by inference, water) and CO2 abundances and their stratigraphic distributions, and determine their seasonal variations, and to determine the depth of the seasonal polar caps and their variation with time.
